description: A vibrant arrangement of makeup products is set against a bright blue background. The composition includes a red cream in a circular container, surrounded by various blue makeup items such as a brush, lipstick, and eyeshadow. The blue eyeshadow is smeared artistically across the surface, creating a textured effect. A dual-toned compact with yellow and blue shades adds contrast to the scene. The lipstick features a striking red tip, complementing the red cream. The overall layout is dynamic, with splashes and smears adding a sense of movement and creativity.
